/-- Helper: for every n there exists a union-free family of size at least C(n, ⌊n/2⌋). -/
lemma erdos447_lower_bound_exists : ∀ n : ℕ,
    ∃ F : Finset (Finset (Fin n)), F.UnionFree ∧ (n.choose (n / 2) : ℕ) ≤ F.card := by
  intro n
  refine ⟨{S : Finset (Fin n) | S.card = n / 2}, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro A B hA hB h
    exact (Finset.card_le_card.1 (Finset.Subset.trans h (Finset.subset_univ A))) (by
      simp [hA, hB])
  · exact Nat.choose_le_self n (n / 2)

/-- Helper: 2^n ≥ C(n, ⌊n/2⌋) for all n. -/
lemma erdos447_binom_le_pow2 : ∀ n : ℕ, (n.choose (n / 2) : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ n := by
  intro n
  have h : n / 2 ≤ n := Nat.div_le_self n 2
  exact Nat.choose_le_two_pow n (n / 2) h

/-- Helper: 2^2^n grows strictly faster than 2^n in the log scale sense:
    2^2^n / 2^n = 2^(2^n - n) → ∞. -/
lemma erdos447_ratio_dives_to_inf :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log 2 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ n - n)) atTop bot := by
  have h₁ : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ n - (n : ℝ)) atTop bot := by
    have h₂ : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) ^ n) atTop bot := by
      simpa using tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)
    have h₃ : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) atTop bot := by simpa using tendsto_id
    exact sub_tendsto_right h₂ h₃
  have h₄ : (0 : ℝ) < Real.log 2 := by
    apply Real.log_pos
    norm_num
  exact (Real.log_mul) (by simp) h₁ h₄
